name: page-recorder-mcp
description: Record clicks and the fetch/XHR APIs behind them in your logged-in Chrome (including cross-origin iframes), then let AI tools replay them or call the APIs directly through MCP / HTTP. Zero dependencies. 录制页面操作和接口（含跨域 iframe），让 Claude Code、Accio 等 AI 工具通过 MCP / HTTP 在你已登录的浏览器里回放，或直接调用接口。
